text: I am writing to you today to request your support for reducing the speed limit on Fairford Avenue, which runs between Coxwell and Woodfield Road. This street has already received a number of traffic calming treatments that mean that the road design is much more in line with a residential street. It also runs right by Roden Public School. I look forward to your support for this measure to help slow down traffic.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated a 30 km/h speed limit on Fairford Avenue, between Woodfield Road and Coxwell Avenue.
